_meta.about: Soil water parameters for the FAO-56 water balance. theta values are volumetric (m3/m3). TAW_per_m_mm = 1000 x (theta_fc - theta_wp). Keys beginning with '_' are documentation.
_meta.source: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 19, 'Typical soil water characteristics for different soil types'. Values are mid-points of the FAO ranges unless noted.
_meta.onboarding: Show only the three 'farmer_choice: true' soils in the form (Sandy / Loam / Clay). The extra classes are for SoilGrids-based suggestions, black-soil cotton/sugarcane regions and sensitivity tests.

sandy.hint_en: Dries fast, does not hold shape when squeezed
sandy.hint_hi: पानी जल्दी सूख जाता है, मुट्ठी में दबाने पर नहीं बँधती
sandy._source: Original spec values (0.15/0.06). They sit at the top of FAO 'sand' and inside 'loamy sand' (FC 0.11-0.19, WP 0.03-0.10), which matches what Punjab farmers call light soil. REW/TEW = loamy-sand mid-points. Percolation: FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual 3, sandy soils 8 mm/day. Hindi text needs native-speaker review.

loam.hint_en: Crumbly, holds shape loosely when squeezed
loam.hint_hi: भुरभुरी, मुट्ठी में हल्की बँधती है
loam._source: FAO-56 Table 19 loam: FC 0.20-0.30, WP 0.07-0.17, REW 8-10, TEW 16-22 (mid-points). Percolation: FAO 'average soils' 5 mm/day.

clay.hint_en: Sticky when wet, cracks when dry
clay.hint_hi: गीली होने पर चिपचिपी, सूखने पर दरारें पड़ती हैं
clay._source: Original spec values, inside FAO-56 Table 19 clay ranges (FC 0.32-0.40, WP 0.20-0.24). FAO mid-points would give 140 mm/m; 120 mm/m is the conservative choice. REW 8-12, TEW 22-29. Percolation: FAO 'heavy clay' 2 mm/day.

loamy_sand._source: FAO-56 Table 19 loamy sand: FC 0.11-0.19, WP 0.03-0.10, REW 4-8, TEW 9-14.

sandy_loam._source: FAO-56 Table 19 sandy loam: FC 0.18-0.28, WP 0.06-0.16, REW 6-10, TEW 15-20. Dominant texture at PAU Ludhiana. Percolation 6 mm/day is an ASSUMPTION between FAO's 'average' (5) and 'sandy' (8); well-puddled fields can be lower.

silt_loam._source: FAO-56 Table 19 silt loam: FC 0.22-0.36, WP 0.09-0.21, REW 8-11, TEW 18-25. Percolation ASSUMPTION.

silty_clay_loam._source: FAO-56 Table 19 silt clay loam: FC 0.30-0.37, WP 0.17-0.24, REW 8-11, TEW 22-27. Percolation ASSUMPTION.

black_vertisol._source: ASSUMPTION for deep black cotton soils (Vertisols) of Maharashtra/MP/Gujarat: FC at the top of FAO clay range (0.32-0.40), WP mid (0.20-0.24). Replace with measured values from your district (NBSS&LUP / state agricultural university soil survey) before using.

_soilgrids_suggestion.about: Optional: suggest a farmer_choice soil from SoilGrids v2.0 (0-30 cm, depth-weighted). Always let the farmer override.
_soilgrids_suggestion._source: ASSUMPTION: a coarse simplification of the USDA texture triangle (sand and loamy sand have >=70% sand; clay class starts at 40% clay). SoilGrids returns sand/clay in g/kg: divide by 10 for %. Resolution 250 m, so treat as a hint only.
